database-migration-premium-always-on.title: Stop the migration service when it is idle
database-migration-premium-always-on.body: This estimate keeps a paid Premium migration service running for the whole month. Microsoft states a stopped service is not billed, so stop it (or delete it) between migration waves and when the migration is finished, and enter only the running hours.

citation.quote: While stopped, it can't be used to run data migrations and the owner won't be billed.

database-migration-free-first-six-months.title: A new 4-vCore Premium service is free for six months
database-migration-free-first-six-months.body: This estimate prices an existing or newly created 4-vCore Premium service at the normal hourly rate. Microsoft says a new Premium 4-vCore service is free for its first six months, so if you create a fresh service for this migration, set newService to true.

citation.quote: DMS Premium 4-vCore is free for 6 months (183 days) from the DMS service creation date before incurring any charges.

database-migration-savings-plan-lifetime.title: A migration service lasts one year at most
database-migration-savings-plan-lifetime.body: This estimate uses a 3-year savings plan for the migration service. Microsoft says a Database Migration Service (classic) resource can be used for up to 1 year from its creation, so a 3-year commitment for it is unlikely to pay off; a savings plan is only worthwhile if the commitment is shared with other compute.

citation.quote: you can use it for up to 1 year from the date of service creation.
